name: Siwang Zhibojian
source:
Anything can be turned into entertainment—even someone else’s death.
The protagonist, Chen Mo, is a Weibo influencer and a self-proclaimed "magician."
His "magic"? The ability to "inhabit" the bodies of the dead.
Using this power, he began live-streaming the deaths of others on Weibo.
The morbid spectacle drew countless viewers, and now he has millions of followers. He’s even planning to write a book.
But one day, something unexpected happens.
Chen Mo, who’s been profiting off live-streaming death, suddenly "jumps" into the body of a living person…

[Translated from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1140610/Death_Live/]steam[/url]]
translation:
任何事物都能变成娱乐——哪怕是别人的死亡。

主人公陈默是微博网红，自称“魔术师”。

他的“魔术”？让意识进入死者身体的能力。

利用这种力量，他开始在微博直播他人的死亡。病态景象吸引无数观众，如今他拥有数百万粉丝，甚至打算写书。

然而某天，意外发生了。靠直播死亡牟利的陈默突然“跳入”了一个活人的身体……

[译自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1140610/Death_Live/]Steam[/url]]
